movie_title: Grown-ups buying kids’ toys ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: It's not just kids who like to play with toys – many adults like to buy kids' toys for themselves! P

vocabulary.definition: an adult who likes playing with toys and games intended for children
vocabulary.example: The toy store hosted a special event for kidults to come and enjoy playing with the latest toys.

vocabulary.definition: a toy doll or animal stuffed with a soft cloth filling
vocabulary.example: She collects plushies of her favorite cartoon characters to decorate her room.

vocabulary.definition: the amount of money you have left to buy whatever you want after paying your expenses
vocabulary.example: After paying all her bills, she used her disposable income to treat herself to a new video game.

vocabulary.definition: the part of an adult's personality that still feels and reacts like a child
vocabulary.example: Painting and coloring help her connect with her inner child and feel carefree.

vocabulary.definition: a number of things, often a large number of things
vocabulary.example: She bought a bunch of plushies from the toy store for her collection.

vocabulary.definition: having free time and nothing much to do with it
vocabulary.example: During the holidays, she found herself with time on her hands and decided to start a new hobby.
